subject.title: [Bug]: Real-time logs of openclaw cron jobs are not displayed in the chat session of the webui

question: Which Web UI surface should show live cron run progress: the selected parent chat, the run-specific chat, Activity/tasks, or an explicit follow/watch mode?
rationale: The source path is clear, but multiple reasonable UX contracts exist and changing routing without that decision could mirror background cron output into the wrong chat surface.

options.title: Define run follow mode
options.body: Add or document a deliberate run-follow surface that subscribes to the run-specific session and shows live progress without changing parent-chat semantics.

options.title: Mirror into parent chat
options.body: Treat cron progress as part of the parent selected chat and update routing/filtering so run-lane events appear there live.

options.title: Use Activity/tasks only
options.body: Keep chat final-only and make Activity/tasks the supported live progress surface for cron runs.

recommendation.title: Define run follow mode
recommendation.body: Add or document a deliberate run-follow surface that subscribes to the run-specific session and shows live progress without changing parent-chat semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The isolated cron execution seam and recent richer cron status work make this the strongest product/implementation routing owner from history.
